tasks.description: Ready to install your eSIM? Choose what you have. We’ll take you to the right next step.

tasks.title: Primary route
tasks.description: I already have my eSIM. Got your QR code or manual installation details? You’re ready to continue. → Install my eSIM

tasks.title: Secondary route
tasks.description: I have a purchase code. Redeem your code to create the eSIM profile you’ll install on your phone. → Redeem purchase code

tasks.title: Owner email
tasks.description: The purchase owner will still receive an email to validate the purchase.

tasks.title: Unlock confirmation
tasks.description: Anyone with the unlocked code can redeem it. Unlocking does not start the plan or remove the owner’s email-validation step.

tasks.title: Transfer state
tasks.description: Locked for transfer → Unlock for transfer → Ready to transfer · not activated → Copy gift message

tasks.title: Recipient entry
tasks.description: Someone’s sent you a connection. Enter the purchase code from your gift message. Your next trip starts with you.

tasks.title: Gift review
tasks.description: A connection, just for you. Unlocked and ready for you. The sender has made this code transferable. Your plan hasn’t started.

tasks.title: Pending validation
tasks.description: One confirmation to go. The purchase owner needs to validate the purchase by email. Ask them to check their inbox, then check again.

tasks.title: Activation and handoff
tasks.description: Ready to use your gift? Redeeming starts your 30 days immediately. Once activated, this gift can’t be transferred again. → Your gift is now your eSIM. → A gift that goes with you.

tasks.title: Plan choices
tasks.description: Activate my plan · Start using it now. / Gift this code · Let them choose when. / My account · Manage my eSIMs.

tasks.title: Confirmation
tasks.description: Your 30 days begin immediately. This code can no longer be gifted. I’m ready to start this plan now.

tasks.title: Inline finish
tasks.description: Here’s your eSIM. → Let’s get you connected. → Make it yours. → You’re connected. (QA-only implementation boundary is recorded in the panel, not in the customer-facing copy.)

tasks.title: Primary data
tasks.description: Choose your Openline eSIM as the primary mobile data line.

tasks.title: Other SIMs and switching
tasks.description: Turn OFF mobile data on other SIMs/eSIMs and automatic data switching.

tasks.title: Roaming
tasks.description: Enable data roaming on your Openline eSIM.

tasks.title: Quick refresh
tasks.description: Turn airplane mode ON, then OFF. Let the network reconnect, then try opening a webpage.

tasks.title: M01 · Your cart
tasks.description: New proposal: review against Irina’s existing app template before importing. Edit quantities, remove or restore an item, and keep totals consistent. Top-up selections return here with the chosen allowance. Production: Cart lines and quotes must come from the commerce backend. Revalidate totals before payment.

tasks.title: M02 · Traveller & receipt
tasks.description: New proposal: review against Irina’s existing app template before importing. A focused receipt-email form with a gifting intention, without inventing a shipping address for a digital product. Production: Validate email on the server; purchasing for someone is not the same as unlocking transfer.

tasks.title: M03 · Payment methods
tasks.description: New proposal: review against Irina’s existing app template before importing. Saved card, wallet and redirect options use one selection pattern and one clear total. No real card details are collected here. Production: Show only PSP methods actually supported by device, currency and country.

tasks.title: M04 · Bank approval
tasks.description: New proposal: review against Irina’s existing app template before importing. Keep the order visible while authentication happens, with a safe return to payment selection. Production: Use the PSP’s hosted 3DS flow. Never collect bank login or OTP inside an Openline imitation.

tasks.title: M05 · Checking payment
tasks.description: New proposal: review against Irina’s existing app template before importing. A calm pending state with status checking, failure recovery and no duplicate pay button. Production: Reconcile the original payment intent and webhook. A timeout is not proof of failure or success.

tasks.title: M06 · Order receipt
tasks.description: New proposal: review against Irina’s existing app template before importing. View line items, total, payment method and the purchased code; continue to the order or code rather than forcing activation. Production: Use server-confirmed paid status, receipt details and actual taxes. The example totals are design fixtures.

tasks.title: M07 · Purchase-code details
tasks.description: New proposal: review against Irina’s existing app template before importing. One place for the code, purchase status and the Activate / Gift / Keep choices. Activated codes no longer offer transfer. Production: Authenticate the purchaser and return validation, redemption and transfer status without consuming the code.

tasks.title: M08 · Unlock for gifting
tasks.description: New proposal: review against Irina’s existing app template before importing. Explain owner validation and the risk of anyone with the code redeeming it; require a separate confirmation. Production: Verify ownership and unused status, record the unlock and preserve the owner-email validation step.

tasks.title: M09 · Your gift is ready
tasks.description: New proposal: review against Irina’s existing app template before importing. Copy the unlocked code with clear redemption instructions, without activating it or claiming an email was sent. Production: The system share route is a separate native implementation. Never expose code-bearing links in analytics.

tasks.title: M10 · Received a gift
tasks.description: New proposal: review against Irina’s existing app template before importing. Review a gift without starting it, handle a locked code and proceed only when eligible. Production: Validate gift eligibility atomically again when redeeming. Never disclose sender account details.

tasks.title: M11 · Waiting for the owner
tasks.description: New proposal: review against Irina’s existing app template before importing. Keep the recipient informed, provide a sender-help message and allow rechecking without bypassing validation. Production: Only a verified server transition can make a pending gift eligible. No email is sent in this reference.

tasks.title: M12 · Ready to start?
tasks.description: New proposal: review against Irina’s existing app template before importing. A large, off-by-default readiness switch and a concise confirmation before the purchase code is consumed. Production: Use current Openline rules: checking does not activate; confirmed activation begins validity and ends gifting.

tasks.title: M13 · Creating your eSIM
tasks.description: New proposal: review against Irina’s existing app template before importing. Progress, retry and success states stay within the same process rather than losing the purchase-code context. Production: Use an idempotent provisioning operation, poll safely, and reconcile unknown outcomes before retrying.

tasks.title: M14 · Your eSIM profile
tasks.description: New proposal: review against Irina’s existing app template before importing. Readable QR, copyable SM-DP+ address and activation code, ICCID and a second-device option. Production: Replace the non-installable fixture with authenticated profile details. EID is a device identifier, not an invented profile field.

tasks.title: M15 · Install your eSIM
tasks.description: New proposal: review against Irina’s existing app template before importing. Keep the QR in view and explain the iPhone or Android route in short, readable steps. Production: Native installation links must use supported OS APIs and real provisioning data. Do not promise one-tap installation universally.

tasks.title: M16 · Set your mobile data
tasks.description: New proposal: review against Irina’s existing app template before importing. Primary data, other-line data, switching and roaming are explicit checks, not a claim that the app changed settings. Production: Treat these as user confirmations. The browser cannot configure the device’s mobile-data settings.

tasks.title: M17 · Make it yours
tasks.description: New proposal: review against Irina’s existing app template before importing. Connection guidance ends with a profile label, folder and a clear route into the account. Production: Provisioned, installed and physically connected are different states. Use actual evidence before asserting connectivity in production.

tasks.title: M18 · Japan eSIM
tasks.description: New proposal: review against Irina’s existing app template before importing. A legible usage card, plan details, quick actions and a useful route back to setup or support. Production: All usage, validity, network and allowance values need authoritative subscription data.

tasks.title: M19 · Label & folder
tasks.description: New proposal: review against Irina’s existing app template before importing. Change a short label and folder without restarting activation; Cancel discards edits. Production: Persist changes to the authenticated owner. UI validation limits here are design choices, not established product rules.

tasks.title: M20 · Your folders
tasks.description: New proposal: review against Irina’s existing app template before importing. Create folders, browse their contents and move a profile with a clear empty state. Production: Scope folders to the correct account and retain membership consistently across devices.

tasks.title: M21 · Add more data
tasks.description: New proposal: review against Irina’s existing app template before importing. Compare fixed allowances, then review the actual cart before paying. Do not promise every profile supports top-up. Production: Quote supported products and confirm whether the existing profile can be used or a replacement is needed.

tasks.title: M22 · Usage & alerts
tasks.description: New proposal: review against Irina’s existing app template before importing. Consistent fixed-plan arithmetic and threshold controls, with functional chart labels instead of decorative telemetry. Production: Usage may be delayed. Notification toggles require permission and durable account settings.

tasks.title: M23 · Let’s get you online
tasks.description: New proposal: review against Irina’s existing app template before importing. Use the same installation recommendations as Start, with short actionable steps and a support handoff. Production: Do not infer the user’s settings or radio condition from checklist clicks.

tasks.title: M24 · About your speed
tasks.description: New proposal: review against Irina’s existing app template before importing. Explain the fixed-allowance guarantee, local MNO rules for unlimited and a best-effort alternative route. Production: No universal speed, threshold, midnight reset or guaranteed improvement is promised.

tasks.title: M25 · Another route
tasks.description: New proposal: review against Irina’s existing app template before importing. Keep the current eSIM until support advises otherwise and request review before any installation or validity changes. Production: Availability, cost and balance/validity carry-over require product confirmation. No silent profile replacement.

tasks.title: M26 · Openline support
tasks.description: New proposal: review against Irina’s existing app template before importing. A short contextual conversation, suggested prompts and an explicit human-review path. Production: Connect real ticket/AI/human systems before claiming messages were delivered or an agent joined.

tasks.title: M27 · Orders & receipts
tasks.description: New proposal: review against Irina’s existing app template before importing. Paid and pending-refund entries with receipt access and a clear status timeline. Production: Use the real payment/refund ledger; do not invent refund deadlines or instantly resolved disputes.

tasks.title: M28 · Privacy & account
tasks.description: New proposal: review against Irina’s existing app template before importing. Clear privacy preferences and separate export/deletion request confirmations with verification requirements. Production: Account export/deletion requires authenticated server workflows and retention-policy disclosure, not a local UI reset.
